# relay-qa

Browser test runner that repairs its own selectors (demo data).

## Install

```sh
# not a heading
npm install relay-qa
```

## Why I built it

Every markup refactor broke tests that had nothing to do with the change, and fixing selectors by hand was most of the QA time.

## What works

- Recording a flow once and replaying it in CI
- Repairing a selector from the last good snapshot

## What doesn't (yet)

Flows that depend on **timing** — animations and debounced inputs — still need a manual wait.

### Known gaps

Shadow DOM is not snapshotted.

## Lessons

Stability beats cleverness: `role` and label selectors survive almost everything.
